messages:
docs-liz: Quick doc bug: API ref for POST /v1/requests/{request_id}/cancel shows 204 No Content and example with no body. Runtime actually returns 200 with a small JSON body `{ \"id\": \"req-9Xc\", \"status\": \"cancelled\" }`. Also SDK snippets expect `canceled: true` (boolean).
eng-tom: yep that changed in the cancellation refactor (we standardized on status enums). Server now returns 200 + status string for clarity. 204 only used when request was already terminal.
docs-liz: can we update examples to show the common 200 path and add a short note about the older 204 case? I want to avoid breaking readers who copied snippets.
eng-tom: sounds good. Quick confirmation curl:
```
curl -i -X POST \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/requests/req-9Xc/cancel
```
Response (current):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Request-Id: abc-xyz-01

{
  "id": "req-9Xc",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "updated_at": "2026-03-12T18:05:30Z"
}
```

sdk-rob: thanks, this explains client breakage we saw in telemetry. Our JS and Go SDKs parse `canceled` boolean. I'll change examples to read `status` and add a migration helper to accept both shapes for one release.
pm-ana: could we add a short migration note in the docs: "Previously examples showed 204/no body or `{ canceled: true }`. New behavior: 200 with `{ id, status }`. Clients should handle both shapes during migration." Also please link the API-changes entry.
docs-liz: will open a small PR to change the example response, adjust the status code, and add the migration note + changelog link. I'll also normalize the example header to `Request-Id` (we should use that casing consistently; servers accept case-insensitive headers but example consistency helps).
ci-bot: docs lint: example response missing schema annotation (warning).
docs-liz: I'll add schema snippet and an explicit example labeled "common response" and "edge case: already terminal -> 204 No Content" to preserve historical behavior in the doc.
eng-tom: filing a quick infra ticket to sweep similar endpoints for `canceled` vs `status` fields. Might be a handful from older PRs.
sdk-rob: once the docs PR merges I'll push SDK PR to accept both `canceled` and `status` and update example snippets. I'll also include a changelog entry referencing the docs migration note.
deploy-bot: PR #5502 (docs): cancel endpoint examples updated  awaiting review :eyes:
docs-liz: pinging @eng-tom and @sdk-rob for quick review. small change but high signal from telemetry.
eng-tom: reviewing now, quick approve if CI green. :thumbsup:
sdk-rob: lgtm, thanks for adding the transitional example.
docs-liz: merging after one more approval; will paste the changelog link when available.
